description: This file contains integration tests for advanced payment allocation and waiving loan charges in the Apache Fineract project. It defines test cases to verify workflows such as adding fees, waiving charges, handling backdated repayments, and loan disbursement with custom payment allocation strategies.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationWaiveLoanCharges
classes.description: Test class for verifying advanced payment allocations and waiving loan charges with various scenarios in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: testAddFeeAndWaiveAdvancedPaymentAllocationNoBackdated
methods.description: Tests adding a fee and waiving it with advanced payment allocation without backdated context.

methods.name: testAddPenaltyAndWaiveAdvancedPaymentAllocationNoBackDated
methods.description: Tests adding a penalty charge and waiving it under advanced payment allocation without backdating.

methods.name: testAddPenaltyAndWaiveAdvancedPaymentAllocationAndBackdatedRepayment
methods.description: Tests the workflow of adding penalties, waiving charges, and making a backdated repayment.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocationWithMixedGrouping
methods.description: Creates a default advanced payment allocation data object with a mix of grouping strategies.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithAdvancedAllocation
methods.description: Creates a loan product configured with advanced payment allocation and specific schedule processing.
